{"code": "sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Verify that the negative values are gone
assert (-1 in sales_df['customer_age'].values) == False, 'Negative customer_age values still present.'

# Now filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[
    (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')
]

# Check if there are any such customers
if filtered_df.empty:
    note_finding('No NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH.', 'The question cannot be answered with available data.')

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders among these
conversion_rate = filtered_df['converted'].mean()

# Print result
conversion_rate"}
